title: Halcyon VoiceWorks
text:
Halcyon VoiceWorks

notes:
POC started Nov 20 2025. Ingested ~50k masked transcripts; SE provisioned eval env and validated streaming + prefix cache. Security review flagged KMS key management and audit logging gaps; Halcyon requested answers (see drive doc). Hiring freeze announced Jan 2026 — 2 infra FTEs reallocated; product deprioritized POC. SE ran cost scenarios (Dedicated 4xA10T est $85k ARR). Competing trials with Anthropic + internal infra spike. Outreach log: 2026-01-22 follow-up email (no reply), 2026-02-14 call (voicemail). Quote from Head of Product on kickoff: "Love the throughput but can't commit headcount right now." Recommended next: exec intro to CTO, 30-day reduced-scope extension, or re-evaluate in Q2 post budget. If no engagement by 2026-04-01, mark as closed-lost. CRM snippets: fragments in notes are intentional — timeline + tasks for renewal.

next_step:
Re-engage with Head of ML after Q2 budget review; offer 30-day POC extension and exec intro if no response.

timeline:
2025-11-12: Lead created via webinar demo signup.
2025-11-20: POC kickoff — data ingest + eval environment provisioned.
2025-12-05: Latency benchmark run (p50=120ms, p95=420ms).
2025-12-18: Halcyon submitted security questionnaire (requested SOC2 evidence, KMS details).
2026-01-08: Hiring freeze announced; engineering owners reallocated.
2026-01-15: SE walkthrough with infra team (fireflies ff_20260115_abc123).
2026-01-22: AE follow-up email (gthr_20260112_x9f7) — no technical reply.
2026-02-14: Last attempted call — voicemail left; awaiting response.
